quote: Telling people a write failed is our idea, not yours.
Nobody asked for it, but with the Save button gone a failed write is otherwise invisible and the person walks away believing a false claim was recorded.
We think it is not optional.
Should unrated and "I have looked at this and it does not apply to me" be the same thing?
If staffing ever wants to distinguish "nobody has assessed this" from "nobody here can do this", the model needs a fourth state and we should know now rather than after migration.
